finding_strata.interpretation: Post-hoc, pair-weighted estimates with nominal 95% percentile intervals from 10000 source-image-cluster bootstrap replicates, base seed 42. Between-stratum contrasts are any-finding minus no-finding-label using independent within-stratum bootstrap samples. Pooled labels mix dataset and finding ascertainment: 819 unascertained BUU and 87 no-finding-labelled VinDr sources versus 94 finding-labelled VinDr sources. Within-VinDr uses 87 versus 94. The two families of 18 model-endpoint contrasts are unadjusted; intervals spanning zero do not establish equivalence.
finding_strata.cell_format: Archived CSV cells retained as strings; column order is explicit.

recommendation_transitions.interpretation: Frozen whole-report, negation- and context-unaware category sets. Addition opportunities have the category absent in the source report; removal opportunities have it present. For A-to-B, opportunities have A present and B absent in the source; events additionally have A absent and B present in the edit report. Other categories can remain or change. These overlapping multi-label cells are not mutually exclusive flows, adjudicated actions, escalation rates, or harm. No transition confidence intervals were saved; the registry has no urgency field.

reader_reliability.interpretation: 450 stratified post-QC pairs; three raters. Q1/Q2 observations are identical and are not independent corroboration. AC1 is a post-hoc sensitivity statistic. The historical verification passed 14/15 checks: exclusions_7=false reflects an unpopulated excluded_final CSV column. Its seven majority-rule failure IDs exactly match the separate radiologist_exclusion_list.json artifact. The failed check is preserved.

source_demographics.interpretation: Released male_or_unknown codes do not identify the number of unknown-sex sources. In VinDr, 104 common-core values at the 45-year missing-age sentinel and 12 zero values were treated as unavailable. The sentinel can collide with genuine age 45; this is an audit classification, not verification that all 104 original ages are missing. BUU metadata were cross-checked against source filenames.

repeated_calls.estimator: equal-source-weight panel means of per-source T and F; normalized = (T-F)/(1-F)
repeated_calls.interpretation: For each source, T averages usable comparisons between each edited report and the source report sharing its pair ID; F averages all unordered comparisons of usable repeated source reports. Sources require at least one usable edited comparison and two usable source reports. API errors and full refusals are excluded; partial refusals remain included. Panel T and F weight sources equally; diagnostic instability is one minus diagnostic Jaccard. Normalized excess is computed after panel averaging and has point estimates only. These post-hoc estimates do not replace the pair-weighted primary table. All 18 raw-excess intervals are unadjusted.
